mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 300 indicates persistent inflation, triggering Fed rate hikes that compress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL exceeds 300, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2 years.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) and declining housing starts (HOUST < 1400) signal labor market overheating with weak consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days via stagflation risk.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting both conditions, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 consecutive months) reduces liquidity and raises discount rates, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with 3 consecutive months of FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls above 150,000 thousand indicate robust labor market strength, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS exceeds 150,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over 2 years.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1400 thousand units signal weak consumer demand for housing, acting as a leading indicator of economic slowdown and causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when HOUST is below 1400, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2 years.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 102.5) combined with tight labor market (UNRATE < 3.5%) indicates manufacturing supply shock amid labor scarcity, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting both conditions, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales above 680,000 million dollars signal late-cycle economic expansion, where market overvaluation and impending Fed tightening cause negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 680,000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3 years.
